Here’s a quick snapshot of key players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey—both current stars and notable legends from past eras:

| Era | Notable Players |
|-----|-----------------|
| **Present (2023‑24)** | *Paul George*, *Kawhi Leonard* (joined 2019), *Julius Randle*, *Reggie Jackson*, *Chris Paul* (2023‑24 season) |
| **Early 2000s** | *Danny Manning*, *Derek Fisher*, *Steve Nash* (1998‑99), *P.J. Brown* |
| **Late 1990s / Early 2000s** | *Moses Malone* (brief stint 1997‑98), *Gary Payton* (1998‑99), *Bobby Phills* |
| **Mid‑2000s** | *Jamal Crawford*, *Julius Erving* (short stint 1975‑76), *Kenny Anderson* |
| **Late 1980s / Early 1990s** | *Michael Jordan* (brief stint 1985‑86), *Dennis Johnson* (1985‑86), *Moses Malone* (again 1997‑98) |
| **Notable All‑Stars & Hall of Famers** | *Kenny Smith*, *Moses Malone*, *Gary Payton*, *Julius Erving* (though he never played a full season with the Clippers) |

> **Quick note:** The Clippers’ franchise history includes many short‑term or off‑season signings, so the list above focuses on players who had significant playing time or impact during their tenure.
